title: Verify: Lockfile node_modules/phaser entry unit tests
summary: Unit test asserts 3.90.x version, URL and integrity in the real lockfile
description: Add tests to the lockfile test file that read the real lockfile and assert the node_modules/phaser entry.
acceptance_criteria: Passes with 3.90.0, matching URL, integrity and eventemitter3 range.

steps.action: Add tests reading lock.packages['node_modules/phaser']: version matches /^3\.90\.\d+$/; resolved equals `https://registry.npmjs.org/phaser/-/phaser-${version}.tgz`; integrity matches /^sha512-[A-Za-z0-9+/]+=*$/ and is not the 4.2.1 hash; dependencies.eventemitter3 toBe '^5.0.1'.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/phaserLockfile.test.ts -t 'node_modules/phaser entry'
steps.expected: All four assertions pass; they fail against the 4.2.1 entry
